proves.claim: with PULLBOARD_CLAIM_PROFILE set, pullboard claim prints one stderr line per claim phase and a total line naming the slowest three, with it unset it prints none, and every phase printed is a step of run() in claim.js.

cli.io-commands-claim.profile-names-phas.why: Without it, the claim-median bar (#10311) has no measured phase to fix, and the profile could drift from the steps claim.js runs.
